information.description:
Most corporate athletes are marketing. In 2061 Moore tried something odd: build a body that could actually do everything in the ads. Champions and record breakers have crossed finish lines in it ever since. It isn't cheap or brawny, and it doesn't need to be.

Cost: 24,000eb (Luxury)
Humanity Loss: 56 (17d6)
Frame: Built in (10): BODY 10
Eyes: MonoVision
Base chrome (no HL): Discount Cyberaudio Suite, Neo-Soviet Cyberarm ×2, Neuroport. This FBC body has a non-removable and non-replaceable Internal Linear Frame that increases the user’s BODY to 10 (Modifies their HP and Death Save)
Chrome: Fortified Ankles ×2, Internal Hydraulics Upgrade (Tuned), Kerenzikov (w/ Kerenzikov Boost System), Leeroy Ligament System ×2 [+2 MOVE], Scalar Hands ×2, Skate Foot (w/ Jenkins Tendons) ×2, Skin Weave (w/ Para Bellum [+1 SP, SP8 Total])

Note: Its built-in Internal Linear Frame sets BODY to 10 (HP and Death Save included) and can't be removed or replaced.

Every body includes the standard chassis (Cyberarm ×2, Cyberaudio Suite, Cyberleg ×2, Cyberskull, an Internal Linear Frame and a Neuroport) at no HL, plus its eyes and base chrome. Going metal needs a Biosystem (bought separately) and a Hospital.
